notes.title: Steam Next Fest Livestream!
notes.content: Join us for our first official livestream. We're really excited to share our game with you for the first time live!

notes.title: Haru: The Armada of the Astral Void - Update 2023-08-11
notes.content:
[b]Features:[/b]
[list]
[*]Photosensitivity warning added at the beginning of the game
[*]Boot Screen with progress added
[/list]

[b]Bug fixes:[/b]
[list]
[*]Fixed: Chance of Exception when destroying the Skull of Doom before its satellites
[*]Fixed: Raygun lights up way too much the player's ship
[*]Fixed: Damage numbers can appear very late when too many on screen
[*]Fixed: Raygun damage is not slightly random as other weapons
[*]Fixed: Raygun fires and has to wait for cooldown even if there are no targets available
[*]Fixed: Multi-shot exploder shouldn't count itself
[/list]

[b]Misc:[/b]
[list]
[*]Cap raygun range
[*]Multi-shot exploder now uses percentage of weapon damage as damage
[*]Mine damage now scales with distance from start
[*]Rebalance pulse cannon projectile count to start at 2
[/list]

notes.title: Haru: The Armada of the Astral Void - Update
notes.content:
[b]Features:[/b]
[list]
[*]Weapons, systems and perks are now shown in the pause menu
[/list]

[b]Bug fixes:[/b]
[list]
[*]Fixed: Controller doesn't always move scrollbar in pause state
[*]Fixed: Next level stat difference is not shown if value is negative (e.g. Cooldown)
[*]Fixed: Projectile count is shown above 1 in menus even if not possible because of Duplication Mirrors
[*]Fixed: When exiting Loadout with Esc key the pause menu opens and closes quickly
[/list]

[b]Misc:[/b]
[list]
[*]EMP max enemy hit count raised to 1000
[*]Enemy movement is pooled to optimize performance
[*]Tractor beam description updated
[*]Raygun projectile count increased to 2 from level 7
[/list]

notes.title: Haru: The Armada of the Astral Void - Update
notes.content:
[b]Features:[/b]
[list]
[*]Worm of Doom length is now influenced by its level
[*]Seed of Evil boss is now faster and shoots further
[*]Enemies that are further now move faster
[*]Pulse cannon can now shoot backwards from projectile count 3
[*]Meteor can now refresh the multiplier
[*]Bosses' speed now scale with their life ratio (they are faster with low life)
[*]Gatling gun is now rotating around the ship instead of shooting forward
[/list]

[b]Bug fixes:[/b]
[list]
[*]Fixed: Leaderboards show only 9 entries instead of top 10
[*]Fixed: Satellites of Skull of Darkness should be evenly placed around it (not offset)
[*]Fixed: Mines can't be hit with weapons anymore
[*]Fixed: Close buttons should not appear in Stats and Leaderboards when using a controller
[*]Fixed: [Full game] Victory text shouldn't have an outline
[*]Fixed: Circle in scanner doesn't appear
[*]Fixed: Raygun doesn't damage enemies
[*]Fixed: Raygun should use duplication mirrors
[*]Fixed: Raygun shouldn't attack nor deal damage to mines
[/list]

[b]Misc:[/b]
[list]
[*]Lottery wheel message moved to the top (same as boss message)
[*]Lottery wheel moved above the minimap so it doesn't hide it
[/list]

notes.title: Haru: The Armada of the Astral Void - Update
notes.content:
[b]Bug fixes:[/b]
[list]
[*]Fixed: When too many sfx happen at once the audio breaks
[*]Fixed: An error can occur when EnemyBoss03 dies but its satellites remain
[/list]

notes.title: Haru: The Armada of the Astral Void - Update
notes.content:
[b]Features:[/b]
[list]
[*]Amount of possible visible items on minimap raised to 200 (ordered by distance)
[*]Random tint added to normal enemies to add variation
[*]Minimap icons added to replace dots (except for enemies)
[*]Starbase will appear on minimap even if above its range
[*]Lottery odds have been rigged so that weapons will appear more often
[*]Keyboard keys rebind is now possible
[/list]

[b]Bug fixes:[/b]
[list]
[*]Fixed: Shocked enemies can still be pushed by other enemies
[*]Fixed: The Critical Situation Generator perk description of critical rate is divided by 100
[*]Fixed: EMP is not damaging or affecting enemies
[*]Fixed: Lottery rings are not awarded
[/list]

[b]Misc:[/b]
[list]
[*]Optimization to minimap performance
[*]Optimization of ring behavior performance
[/list]

notes.title: Haru: The Armada of the Astral Void - Update
notes.content:
[b]Features:[/b]
[list]
[*]Score is now added on enemy kills (not on ring pickups)
[*]Every game now has a different environment
[/list]

[b]Bug fixes:[/b]
[list]
[*]Fixed: Wrong enemy explosion on normal enemies (it should be the smaller one)
[*]Fixed: Best score shown in menu is wrong (it's showing most amount of rings at the end of a game instead)
[*]Fixed: Mines are z fighting (They should have a different order in layer)
[*]Fixed: Sparks on hit do not appear at hit location
[*]Fixed: Boost is not working in the first few seconds of a game
[*]Fixed: Perks section is seen even if none are equipped
[/list]

notes.title: Haru: The Armada of the Astral Void - Update
notes.content:
[b]Features:[/b]
[list]
[*]EMP now has a shocking effect on enemies
[*]Skull boss enemy now throws its satellites at the player when it dies
[*]Burning effect added on Orbital Flamethrower projectiles
[*]Affliction framework added to support multiple affliction from different existing and future weapons
[/list]

[b]Misc:[/b]
[list]
[*]Enemy behavior is now aimed more towards the player and less for clustering together
[/list]

notes.title: Haru: The Armada of the Astral Void - Update
notes.content:
[b]Feature:[/b]
[list]
[*]Perks are now combined with weapons and systems in the lower left part of the screen
[*]Minimap added
[*]Control scheme added where direction and thrusters are both on the left stick
[/list]

[b]Bug fixes:[/b]
[list]
[*]Fixed: Description of critical perk has an error with its percentage
[*]Fixed: Explosion hazard and perks are not visible in Result Screen as best weapon
[*]Fixed: Explosion hazard and perks are not visible in Leaderboards as best weapon
[*]Fixed: Meteors should have a collider and damage player
[*]Fixed: Stats window shouldn't have Tabs anymore
[/list]

notes.title: Haru: The Armada of the Astral Void - Update
notes.content:
[b]Features:[/b]
[list]
[*]The leaderboards window now have a filter for the time period, Best of All-Time, Best of Current Year, Best of Current Month
[*]The main menu has now a Records sub-menu, that leads to Compendium, Stats and Leaderboards
[*]The leaderboards window is now separate from the Stats window
[/list]

[b]Bug fixes:[/b]
[list]
[*]Fixed: Boosting without activating thrusters takes energy but does nothing
[/list]
